shortDescription: The Testimonial Quote Card Slider extends the single Quote Card into an interactive carousel for displaying multiple customer testimonials. It includes all styling options from the single card variant while adding slider-specific controls like optional scrollbar. Each slide contains a complete testimonial with name, position, company, quote, optional star rating, profile picture, and company logo. Ideal for showcasing a collection of top ratings and customer stories without taking excessive vertical space.
